findings.reason: without a reachability check beyond the two routes (public exports plus the coupled repositories' imports), the node's own gate passes while it deletes live library code, which is the one irreversible action in the plan.
findings.text: §4 deletes every `nova/` module "§1 shows unreached by either route" whose guards are only kept tests and live/held plans, but the two measured routes are the forward solve and the inverse fit; the rest of the package (transport, assembly, biot and its public API, media, apps, and the API that the coupled repositories in `AGENTS.md` call) is reached by entry points §1 never exercises. A working module whose only callers are an adjacent repository, a bokeh app or a kept script can read zero coverage and be deleted, and the §4 negative control — a §1-reached module being refused — cannot detect that case

findings.reason: four independent nodes each pick their own location, and the plan's own cross-section reads (§3 consumes §2, S28 consumes §5) then depend on a path nobody fixed.
findings.text: §2's census, §3's batch records, §4's per-package record and §5's duplicates register are each "one record" with no durable path, unlike §1 which names `docs/evidence/fragments/code-reuse-and-hot-path/hot-path-map.html`; §2's verdicts and §5's entries are consumed by later sections and by S28, so a record left in a session scratchpad makes those consumers unable to find it

findings.reason: the completion condition is owned by another sprint with no declared handoff, so a worker either blocks on an unanswered external actor or closes §5 as met when it is not.
findings.text: §5's done-when (2) requires "S28's coordinator has answered it: accepted for an S28 node, or declined", and §6's premise is the route "as measured after the §5 collapses S28 accepted have landed"; the only declared relationship toward S28 is `plan-informs`, which is a one-way record and carries no answer and no landing signal, so a node dispatched at this plan's head cannot satisfy §5(2) on any in-plan dependency

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every cited file resolves (`nova/equilibrium/AGENTS.md`, the six §0 modules, both informed plans); the evidence fragment under `docs/evidence/fragments/code-reuse-and-hot-path/` is a deliverable rather than an existing target, and its house directory convention exists; no extensionless href is cited.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — each section names a negative control that can fail: an unreached module reading zero lines (§1), a live-test-imported driver forced to delete being refused (§2), a kept file naming a deleted path failing the absence check (§3), a reached module offered for deletion being refused (§4), a perturbed-input disagreement exceeding tolerance (§5), and an added module breaking the head comparison (§6).
